review_evidence: README describes a Lean formalization of the Virasoro algebra, Witt algebra, Lie algebra cohomology, central extensions, Heisenberg algebra, Sugawara construction, generalized Verma modules, and Fock-space representations.

The README records proved structural results including one-dimensional second cohomology of the Witt algebra and applicability of the Sugawara construction; direct inventory contains 32 Lean files and hundreds of proposition declarations.
Supporting API modules for Lie cohomology and central extensions are themselves reusable formal prior art, so the complete formal-source unit is retained.
summary: Retain the Virasoro/Lie-algebra formalization and its supporting API development without hard exclusions.

summary: Surveyed all 40 in-scope files: the root VirasoroProject.lean import umbrella, the core VirasoroProject/* Lie-algebra/Virasoro-algebra development (sampled the largest file, Sugawara.lean, and the smallest ToMathlib helpers, ConstMulAction.lean and Topology/Order.lean), and the entire blueprint-verso/* subtree (a Verso-based blueprint: TeXPrelude.lean, the Blueprint.lean/VirasoroBlueprint.lean/VirasoroBlueprintMain.lean document-tree files, all eight Chapters/*.lean files including the smallest, Introduction.lean, and the largest, Sugawara.lean, plus blueprint-verso/lakefile.lean). The core library files hold genuine formal content: real theorem/lemma/def/structure/instance declarations with substantive docstrings on the Virasoro/Heisenberg/Witt Lie-algebra and Sugawara-construction mathematics. The blueprint Chapters/*.lean files hold genuine informal mathematical exposition via the Verso `#doc`/`:::definition ...(lean := ...)` DSL, explicitly cross-referencing the corresponding Lean declarations by name -- substantive auxiliary documentation, not navigation stubs, and Introduction.lean's minimal '_Under construction._' body is a real (if not yet written) chapter placeholder, not junk. TeXPrelude.lean is a real file of executable `tex_prelude` macro-registration commands, which places it outside the FILTER-007 pure-import class regardless of size. VirasoroProject.lean, blueprint-verso/VirasoroBlueprint.lean, and blueprint-verso/VirasoroBlueprint/Blueprint.lean are prover/format-aware-verified pure import aggregators (module-tree navigation for the library and the Verso document respectively) and are retained per FILTER-007. blueprint-verso/lakefile.lean, read in full, contains only Lake DSL build/dependency configuration (`import Lake`, `require ... from ...`, `package ... where`, `lean_lib ... where`) and no formal mathematical declaration of any kind -- it is excluded under FILTER-004 condition 1, following the same content-level reasoning already applied to lakefile.lean-type files elsewhere in this review batch (e.g. the separately recorded mortarsanjaya/IMOSLLean4 lakefile.lean exclusion). The corpus-wide standard declaration-keyword grep over the exact 40-file scope found exactly 6 files without a theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/elab/noncomputable keyword, all individually inspected above; the junk-signal grep found 0 lorem-ipsum/dummy/XXX matches and only 4 ordinary in-proof TODO/FIXME comments across 4 already-confirmed-genuine core files.
